author: bardic-inspiration
name: Quilted Ward
summary: Padded armor that dulls the weight of a fall and a blow.
description: Grandmothers in the hill country quilt these with charms in the lining. The charms are mostly dried herbs.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. When you take Bludgeoning damage, you can use your Reaction to reduce that damage by 3.
